opportunities.name: GitHub developer research to draft hiring lead email
opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username, find the user's profile and top repo, then fill a mail draft to hiring@example.com with a summary and discard it.
steps: Click GitHub search button and focus the search box
Type the username (ctrl+a first if text exists) and press Enter
Click the Users filter in results
Open the top/pinned repository to read stars and language
Open the mail New message form and click To
Click Body and type '<username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <post>.'

opportunities.name: Person lookup on Wikipedia, Wayback snapshot of related site, and note
opportunities.description: Search a person on Wikipedia, open the Wayback Machine for a related domain at a given year, then save a combined note.
steps: Search the person on Wikipedia and read the summary
Open the Wayback Machine and enter the domain
Select the year in the timeline and click a calendar date
Open Notes, click New note, type '<person>: born ..., role. <domain> in <year>: <headline>' and press Enter
